solution: Group as $[(1+\sqrt{2})^{2}-(\sqrt{3})^{2}]\cdot[(1-\sqrt{2})^{2}-(\sqrt{3})^{2}]$. The first factor is $1+2\sqrt{2}+2-3=2\sqrt{2}$; the second is $1-2\sqrt{2}+2-3=-2\sqrt{2}$. Their product is $(2\sqrt{2})(-2\sqrt{2})=-8$. Hence the whole product equals $-8$.
